privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Huishouden is a set of free apps for running a household. This is what they keep, what they send and why.
privacy.dataBody: What you add (lists, logs, bills, contacts, reminders) is stored in your household's own space and is visible only to the members of your household. It is never sold or used for advertising. Apps that read your Gmail or Calendar do so only after you allow it, from your own browser.
privacy.sendTitle: What the apps send to help fix problems
privacy.sendErrors: Errors: when something breaks, which app and version, and what failed, with addresses and ids taken out.
privacy.sendSpeed: Speed: how long screens take to load and respond.
privacy.sendUsage: Anonymous usage counts: which screens and features are used, counted per visit.
privacy.sendRegion: Roughly where you are, worked out from your internet connection's address: country, region and city, and your internet provider's network with its approximate point on a map. This is often a nearby city rather than your own, and never your device's location. Your device type and browser.
privacy.neverBody: Your name, email address, your household or anything in it, anything you type, or your device's location. No cookies or stored ids are used for these reports, so nothing links one visit to the next, and nothing is used for advertising.
privacy.gpcTitle: If your browser asks not to be tracked
privacy.gpcBody: When your browser sends Global Privacy Control (or Do Not Track), the apps don't send usage counts. Error and speed reports still go, with the rough location above: they keep the apps working and contain nothing you entered.
privacy.providerFirebase: Google Firebase: sign-in, your household's data, and hosting the apps.
privacy.providerNewRelic: New Relic: the error, speed and usage reports, deleted after 8 days.
privacy.providerCloudflare: Cloudflare: sending the notifications you turn on.
privacy.providerGoogle: Google (Gmail, Calendar, Contacts): only when you allow it, from your browser.
privacy.code: The apps' code is public, including {link}.

intro.step2: Start a household, or join the one you were invited to.
intro.step3: Open any app. Add it to your home screen to keep it close.

assistant.title: Use Huishouden from your AI assistant
assistant.intro: Ask your own AI assistant (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or any app that takes an MCP server) what's on today, add groceries, log a feed or a dose, or look up someone's medicines. It works in your language and your time zone.
assistant.rules: The assistant acts as you: it sees and changes only what your role in the household allows, exactly as in the apps. Health answers come from your household's own records and are not medical advice.
assistant.notAvailable: Connecting an assistant isn't available on this site yet.
assistant.claude1: Open Settings, then Connectors, and choose Add custom connector.
assistant.claude2: Name it Huishouden and paste the connector address above.
assistant.claude3: Choose Connect, sign in with Google on the Huishouden page, and allow it.
assistant.chatgpt1: Open Settings, then Apps & Connectors. Under Advanced settings, turn on Developer mode.
assistant.chatgpt2: Choose Create, name it Huishouden, paste the connector address above and pick OAuth.
assistant.chatgpt3: Sign in with Google on the Huishouden page and allow it. In a chat, turn on Huishouden from the tools menu.
assistant.gemini1: Add this to ~/.gemini/settings.json (merge it with what is there):
assistant.gemini2: Start gemini and run /mcp auth huishouden; a browser opens for you to sign in and allow it.
assistant.signIn: Sign in to see the assistants you have connected.
assistant.revokeFailed: Couldn't disconnect it just now. Try again.
connect.title: Connect {client} to Huishouden
connect.invalid: This connection request didn't come from Huishouden's connector. Start again from your assistant.
connect.signInFirst: Sign in to Huishouden to connect {client}.
connect.what: It can see and change your household's things in Huishouden as you, and Health for the people you care for. The household's rules still decide everything, exactly as in the apps.
connect.revokeLater: You can disconnect it any time: account menu, Use with your AI assistant.
connect.failed: Connecting didn't work. Try again, or start again from your assistant.
myCalendar.title: In your own calendar
myCalendar.intro: See the household's appointments, regular events like garbage pickup, upkeep that's due, bills and things to do in the calendar you already use, on your phone and computer.
myCalendar.privacy: Your calendar shows only what you can see in Huishouden, in your language. Nobody else sees your link or your settings.
myCalendar.signIn: Sign in to set up your calendar.
myCalendar.noHousehold: Join or start a household first.
myCalendar.notAvailable: Calendars aren't available on this site yet.
myCalendar.dailyLimit: Huishouden has used up today's allowance for this. It works again tomorrow.
myCalendar.signedOut: Your calendar stopped updating because you were signed out everywhere. Set it up again below to start it.
myCalendar.googleIntro: Adds a "Huishouden" calendar to your Google account and keeps it up to date within about 5 minutes. Move, rename or delete something there and Huishouden changes too.
myCalendar.googleUnavailable: Google Calendar sync isn't set up on this site yet. The calendar link below works with Google Calendar too.
myCalendar.googleScope: Google asks to let Huishouden make its own calendar. Huishouden can't see your other calendars.
myCalendar.refused: {n, plural, one {A change you made in Google Calendar couldn't be made in Huishouden, so it was put back.} other {# changes you made in Google Calendar couldn't be made in Huishouden, so they were put back.}}
myCalendar.synced: Google Calendar is up to date
myCalendar.twoWay: When something changes both in Huishouden and in Google Calendar, the most recent change wins.
myCalendar.calendarDeleted: The Huishouden calendar was deleted in Google, so it stopped updating. Connect again to get it back.
myCalendar.feedTitle: Calendar link for any calendar app
myCalendar.feedIntro: A private link that Apple Calendar, Google Calendar, Outlook and other calendar apps can subscribe to. It's read-only: change things in Huishouden.
myCalendar.feedSecret: Anyone with this link can see your calendar. If you shared it by mistake, get a new link.
myCalendar.appleHow: Apple Calendar on iPhone, iPad and Mac opens and asks to subscribe. It updates about every hour.
myCalendar.googleHow: Google Calendar takes up to a day to show changes from a link. For quicker updates, connect Google Calendar above.
myCalendar.outlookHow: Outlook adds it as a calendar from the web, which updates every few hours.
myCalendar.otherHow: Other apps: copy the link and add a calendar "from URL" or "by subscription".
myCalendar.rotateBody: Your old link stops working. Calendars that use it stop updating until you add the new one.
myCalendar.rotated: New link ready. Add it to your calendar apps again.
myCalendar.revokeBody: Calendars that use it stop updating. You can make a new link at any time.
myCalendar.disconnectBody: Huishouden stops updating your Google Calendar and forgets its access to your Google account.
myCalendar.deleteCalendar: Also delete the Huishouden calendar from Google Calendar
myCalendar.disconnected: Disconnected. The Huishouden calendar stays in Google Calendar but no longer updates.
myCalendar.disconnectedDeleted: Disconnected and the Huishouden calendar deleted
myCalendar.showsIntro: These choices apply to your calendar link and to Google Calendar.
myCalendar.healthDetailHint: Off: Health items only say "Medicine for Ana". Calendars are often shared, so turn this on only if nobody else sees yours.
myCalendar.saveFailed: Couldn't save that. Check the connection and try again.
myCalendar.historyIntro: What you changed in Google Calendar and Huishouden changed with it.
myCalendar.undoFailed: Couldn't undo that. It may have changed since.
myCalendar.googleCancelled: Google Calendar wasn't connected. Try again when you're ready.
myCalendar.popupBlocked: The browser blocked Google's window. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
myCalendar.googleDenied: Google didn't allow Huishouden to make its calendar. Try again and tick the box for Google Calendar.
myCalendar.offline: Couldn't reach the calendar service. Check the connection and try again.
myCalendar.failed: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.
myCalendar.errorRevoked: Huishouden's access to your Google account was removed. Disconnect and connect again.
myCalendar.errorSignedOut: You were signed out everywhere, so updates stopped. Disconnect and connect again.
myCalendar.errorMember: You're no longer in this household, so updates stopped.
myCalendar.errorGoogle: Google Calendar didn't take the last update. It tries again in a few minutes.
